ChucksWifeEasierToFlyText:
You crossed the
sea to get here?

That must have
been hard.

It would be much
easier if your

#MON knew how
to FLY…
ChucksWifeBeatChuckText:
But you can't use
FLY without this city's GYM BADGE.

If you beat the
GYM LEADER here, come see me.

I'll have a nice
gift for you.
ChucksWifeGiveHMText:
That's CIANWOOD's
GYM BADGE!

Then you should
take this HM.
ChucksWifeFlySpeechText:
Teach FLY to your
#MON.

You will be able
to FLY instantly

to anywhere you 
have visited.
ChucksWifeChubbyText:
My husband lost to
you, so he needs to train harder.

That's good, since
he was getting a little chubby.
CianwoodCityYoungsterText:
If you use FLY,
you can get back

to OLIVINE in-
stantly.
CianwoodCityPokefanMText:
Boulders to the
north of town can be crushed.

They may be hiding
something.

Your #MON could
use ROCK SMASH to break them.
CianwoodCityLassText:
CHUCK, the GYM
LEADER, spars with

his fighting #-
MON.
CianwoodCityUnusedText:
There are several
islands between here and OLIVINE.

A mythical sea
creature supposed- ly lives there.
EusineSuicuneText:
EUSINE: Yo,
{PLAYER}.

Wasn't that
SUICUNE just now?

I only caught a
quick glimpse, but

I thought I saw
SUICUNE running on the waves.

SUICUNE is beau-
tiful and grand.

And it races
through towns and

roads at simply
awesome speeds.

It's wonderful…

I want to see
SUICUNE up close…

I've decided.

I'll battle you as
a trainer to earn SUICUNE's respect!

Come on, {PLAYER}.
Let's battle now!
EusineBeatenText:
I hate to admit
it, but you win.
EusineAfterText:
You're amazing,
{PLAYER}!

No wonder #MON
gravitate to you.

I get it now.

I'm going to keep
searching for SUICUNE.

I'm sure we'll see
each other again.

See you around!
